newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt extends deadline for bids for food firm.
newsitem.headline: Egypt extends deadline for bids for food firm.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Holding Company for Food Industries said on Monday it was extending until September 29 the deadline for bids for 90 percent of its subsidiary Bisco Misr/Egyptian Foods.
The company had originally set September 10 as the last day for bids from a strategic investor. The remaining 10 percent of the firm will be sold to company employees.
Bisco Misr makes pastries, breakfast cereals, chewing gum, chocolate, biscuits and confectionery in five factories in Cairo, Alexandria and Ismailia.

The firm, which has a capital of 10 million pounds, has forecast that pre-tax profits for the 1995/96 financial year which ended on June 30, 1996, will fall to 1.02 million pounds from 1.61 million a year earlier.
But it also predicted they would triple to 3.00 million in the 1996/97 financial year, which began on July 1, 1996.
The sale is part of the government's privatisation programme.
